records.text: Greg Shaffer worked for the FBI Hostage Rescue Team, supervised the Dallas Joint Terrorism Task Force, and was stationed in Budapest.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He also is from Dallas, Texas, working for the FBI on the elite Hostage Rescue Team. He was a supervisor on the Dallas Joint Terrorism Task Force. And get this, also another Eastern European connection because he was also a part of their organization in Budapest. In Budapest, Hungary, if you didn't know, the FBI also has sub offices all around the globe. And Greg was at least stationed in Budapest. He probably was stationed in other places.

verification.notes: A detailed published Greg Shaffer biography confirms FBI Hostage Rescue Team service, supervision of the North Texas Joint Terrorism Task Force in the Dallas Division, and service as FBI Legal Attaché in Budapest. The transcript's 'Dallas Joint Terrorism Task Force' wording is a minor naming simplification.
